This '''medical examiner''' served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The examiner treated [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] wounds following his seven-day ordeal in the [[Tarko-se Arena]].
